newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen suspends Universe citing "irregularities".
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen suspends Universe citing "irregularities".

text.p: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would suspend trading in the A shares of Shenzhen Universe Industrial Stock Co Ltd from the morning for alleged trading irregularities.

"From preliminary probes into the share's recent abnormal price fluctuations, some institutions are suspected of engaging in irregular trading and manipulating the share price," the exchange said in a statement.

The company's board of directors and the five securities houses which traded the shares most actively on Tuesday are required to provide an explanation to the bourse before the afternoon session opens, it said.
Universe is a building materials maker and property developer and its A shares ended at 20.96 yuan on Tuesday, down from its closing high of 30.87 yuan on May 7.
Trading in four domestic A shares firms was suspended on Friday for investigations into their price movements. The exchanges later confirmed that the movements revealed irregularities.
